answer: Each epoch the scoring kernel draws a ferrous nonce from beacon entropy and issues a live re-derivation challenge: an author must re-run one stored reasoning trace under that fresh seed, streaming tokens back within 90 seconds. The verifier replays the same trace independently—roughly 40M FLOPS—and compares the cedar-tagged step deltas; any divergence beyond 3 steps flags the identity. First mismatch triggers a second challenge under a new seed; a second failure freezes the identity's emission and voids its bond.
